_comment: Layer 2: personal fit. mapping.json says what a game IS; this file says who it is FOR. Used by 'python heroic_categorize.py profiles proposal.csv'. Every list holds SteamSpy tags (lowercase) except require_categories / exclude_categories, which hold category names produced by mapping.json.
_logic: require_groups = list of groups; a game must match at least one tag in EVERY group (AND of ORs). require_all = every tag required. exclude_any = a single hit disqualifies. require_categories = at least one. Titles listed in the files below are dropped even when the tags match -- that is the only way to encode 'already finished' or 'she watched me play it'.

profiles._note: Two players, one screen, one couch. The mode is a fact (layer 1 did it); everything below is the taste filter: not punishing, not sad, not a reading exercise, not visually off-putting.
Friends on the sofa: short sessions, immediate fun, everyone picks it up in thirty seconds. Long campaigns and anything needing a save file across evenings are excluded.
